The Chinese characters for Lucas

As a transliteration, Lucas is usually written 卢卡斯 (Lú kǎ sī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

From Latin, Lucas carries the meaning “from Lucania”.

About the name Lucas

A Latin form of Luke that has been a top pick across Europe and the Americas.
